THIS ROW IS AN ASSESSMENT, NOT A PARITY VERDICT — there is no Limbo UI to compare 14 frames against, so nothing here claims match/partial on a frame. ★★★ CORRECTION 2026-08-19, SAME DAY, THE TREE MOVED UNDER THIS ASSESSMENT AND THREE CLAIMS BELOW WENT STALE WITHIN HOURS — read this before the body. (i) "There is no POINTS path" IS NOW FALSE. supabase/functions/_shared/limbo.ts now exists (LIMBO_EDGE_MUL_BPS 9900, LIMBO_MIN/MAX_TARGET_BPS 10100/10000000, limboWinThreshold, settleLimboRound) and supabase/functions/points-game/index.ts wires it end to end — `play_limbo` at :2136, target parsed and bounds-checked at :5173-5185, settled at :5513-5528. So the rail question this row raised is ANSWERED, and answered in the frames' favour: POINTS settles limbo at a 1% edge, matching the chain and the frames, NOT at Dice's 5%. game-settlement/index.ts still has zero limbo. (ii) THE KEEPER DOC DEFECT IS FIXED — main.go now reads ":314 Limbo: target multiplier in BASIS POINTS, i.e. x10000 (20000 = 2.00x)" and keeps a note recording the old wrong text; the neighbouring Dice line was corrected too. Leaving it listed as an open violation would be actively harmful, which is why it is struck below rather than left standing. (iii) EVERY skai-chain LINE NUMBER IN THIS ROW SHIFTED, because gaming.go and gaming_settle_models.go were edited mid-session: settleLimbo 352 -> :388-410, edgeMulBPS 131 -> :141, the GameLimbo registry row 261 -> :276, HouseEdgeBPS 78 -> :93. gaming.go:48 and keeper :130/:185 are unchanged. The FACTS all re-verified identical; only the offsets moved. Cite by symbol, not by line, in a tree this many lanes are writing to. ALSO NEW AND NOT MINE: modules/skai-gaming/src/components/play/games/instant/limboOdds.ts + limboOdds.test.ts, and modules/skai-gaming/src/assets/games/figma/limbo.webp. STILL ABSENT, which is why this row stays `not-started`: there is no LimboGame.tsx, the `instant` barrel does not export one, there is no route and no Play.tsx registration — so no Limbo FRAME is implemented by anything, and the frame-parity verdict is unchanged even though the backend is now largely built. WHAT I VERIFIED RATHER THAN ASSUMED. (a) CLIENT: I could find NO Limbo component, page, tile, route, game-art entry or feature flag anywhere. Swept `src/`, `modules/skai-gaming/src/`, `modules/skai-ui/` and `supabase/functions/` case-insensitively for limbo/Limbo/LIMBO. Every hit is a bare identifier or an unrelated English use of the word: modules/skai-gaming/src/services/gaming/gameSettlementService.ts:494 `limbo: 'limbo'` inside GAME_TYPE_ALIASES; gameCanonParams.ts:171 names limbo in a COMMENT listing games that return `null` (no bindable params); gameTypeNormalization.test.ts:52,110 asserts the alias; crash/TowerStackerPro.tsx:5 mentions "Stake.com Tower/Limbo" in a docblock; src/services/user/badgeEventService.ts:1164 lists "limbo" in a 14-name array for the play-all-games badge — note that check is `uniqueGameTypes.size >= allGameTypes.length`, a COUNT not a membership test, so the badge is NOT blocked by Limbo being unbuilt; supabase/functions/poker-engine/potCalculator.ts:222 and a 2021-era archived drop script use the English word. Play.tsx has no limbo entry (compare price-grid, which needs Play.tsx:181 flag map + :496 catalog + :827 nav + :968 + :1031 + :1720 switch, playGameArt.ts:138, GameDetailPage.tsx:268, src/App.tsx:1480 route and a PlayPriceGrid.tsx page). (b) SERVER — AND THIS IS THE FINDING THAT CHANGES THE SHAPE OF THE JOB: LIMBO IS ALREADY FULLY IMPLEMENTED ON-CHAIN. modules/skai-chain/core/gaming/gaming.go:48 declares `GameLimbo`, :261 registers `{MinParam: 10100, MaxParam: 10000000, Settle: settleLimbo}` (target multiplier scaled x10000, so 1.01x..1000.00x), gaming_settle_models.go:352-366 is the settle function, cmd/skai-gaming-keeper/main.go:130 accepts `"limbo": true` and :185 publishes it on /games with `HouseEdgeBPS: 100`, gaming_extra_test.go:216-257 tests it, and cmd/skai-badge-keeper/main.go:832 already emits a `limbo_count` badge event for game-type byte 0x04. So the SKAI/sUSD rail can settle Limbo today. What does NOT exist is any OTHER rail: `limbo` appears NOWHERE in supabase/functions/game-settlement/index.ts or supabase/functions/points-game/index.ts, so there is no POINTS path and no edge-function path. (c) DATA, live prod hpongymihuyqgcecowjr: `game_history` has ZERO limbo rows ever (distinct game_type across the whole table is only blackjack, crash_live, hilo, plinko, sports_bet, vegasslots); `site_config` has ZERO limbo keys (price_grid has 1, dice has gaming_dice_max_bet, crash has gaming_crash_max_bet) so Limbo would ship with no admin max-bet/config row — the gaming-config-rows-missing failure mode, pre-emptively; `feature_flags` has ZERO limbo row. FRAME CENSUS: 14 frames on page 9929:16390, NINE REAL / FIVE SCAFFOLDING, which independently reproduces the prior 9-of-14 count. Real: 2 full page screens (1440x3294 desktop, 375x1605 mobile), 2 desktop board states, 1 mobile board state, 2 desktop bet panels, 2 mobile bet panels. Scaffolding: 1 Directory title card, 3 Breakpoint labels, 1 pasted cover raster. NOTE THE BREAKPOINT LABELS PROMISE A TIER THAT WAS NEVER DRAWN — 9948-24616 says "Tablet (768px)" and there is NO 768 frame in the section; only 1440 and 375 exist. WHAT THE FRAMES SHOW ABOUT ODDS — RECORDED AS DESIGN, NOT ASSERTED AS TRUTH. The frames print two different parameterisations. Desktop (9948-24618, 10004-29637, 10004-29705) prints Multiplier `2.00` with Win Chance `49.50000000`. Mobile (9948-25380, 10021-30111) prints Multiplier `1.9800` with Win Chance `50.0000`. Both are the 99/chance relation, i.e. a 1% house edge, and BOTH AGREE EXACTLY WITH THE CHAIN: settleLimbo wins iff `scaled < edgeMulBPS * OutcomeScale / target` with `edgeMulBPS = 10000 - HouseEdgeBPS = 9900` (gaming_settle_models.go:131, gaming.go:78), so P(win) = 9900/target — 9900/20000 = 49.5% and 9900/19800 = 50.0000%, to the printed digit. THIS IS THE OPPOSITE OF THE KENO RESULT and the contrast is the point: Keno's frames were found printing payouts matching no row of the real server table, so a design's numbers are never a source of truth for money — here they happen to match a rail that exists, and that was CHECKED against gaming_settle_models.go rather than believed. THREE ODDS CAVEATS STILL STAND AND MUST NOT BE BUILT PAST. (1) The desktop frames are INTERNALLY INCONSISTENT: they pair Multiplier `2.00` with a label reading "Potential Profit: (1.98x)". Against settleLimbo the payout for target 20000 is exactly 2.00x the stake (profit 1.00x), not 1.98x — the frame appears to apply the 1% edge a second time on the payout after it is already priced into the win chance. The mobile frames do not have this problem (target 1.9800 with 50.0000% is self-consistent). Whichever tier is copied literally decides whether the player is quoted the right number. (2) THE PLATFORM DOES NOT AGREE WITH ITSELF ABOUT HOUSE EDGE ACROSS RAILS, and Limbo would inherit that on day one. The chain sets ONE edge for every game (HouseEdgeBPS = 100, 1%), while the edge-function/POINTS rail for the mechanically identical Dice runs at 95 RTP / 5% — diceOdds.ts:20 `RTP_PERCENT = 95`, with a docblock recording that the client once used "99/winChance (1% edge) which OVERSTATED the pre-roll payout vs settlement". A Limbo widget built to these frames displays 1% odds; a POINTS Limbo settling like Dice would pay 5%-edge odds; the numbers in these frames are only correct for the chain rail. (3) FIXED 2026-08-19, RECORDED HERE ONLY FOR THE LESSON — DO NOT RE-REPORT: cmd/skai-gaming-keeper/main.go used to document the wire param as "Limbo: target multiplier * 100 (e.g., 200 = 2.00x)" while settleLimbo divides by 10000 and MinParam is 10100, i.e. wrong by 100x. It failed CLOSED (a client following the comment would send 200, below MinParam, and be rejected) rather than mispaying. It now reads ":314 target multiplier in BASIS POINTS, i.e. x10000 (20000 = 2.00x)" and carries a note of the old text; the Dice line beside it was wrong too and was corrected in the same pass. The lesson worth keeping: the defect was in a comment block whose OTHER entries were right, which is what made it credible. NEAREST SHIPPING SIBLING — THE ANSWER IS SPLIT AND THAT MATTERS FOR THE ESTIMATE. For CHROME AND PANEL: crash, modules/skai-gaming/src/components/play/games/crash/AviatorGamePro.tsx. The frames' bet panel is the crash panel almost part for part — Manual|Auto tabs, Bet amount with 1/2 / 2X / Max chips, Balance row, Potential Profit, and an auto block whose fields (Number of Bets with 0 = run until stopped, Advanced disclosure, On Win / On Loss with Reset + Increase By, Stop on Win, Stop on Loss) are already modelled in crash/autoBetRules.ts + autoBetRules.test.ts, and the mobile frames repeat crash's documented inversion (CTA first, Manual|Auto tabs LAST — 10021-30457 and 10021-30525 both put CTA/button at y=16 and the tabs at y=309/637, where desktop 10004-29756 / 10004-29965 put tabs at y=16 and CTA last). crash/betPanelLayout.ts already encodes that ordering. For MECHANICS AND MATH: crash is NOT the closest — Dice and Price Grid are. Limbo is not a rising multiplier the player races; it is a SINGLE INSTANT ROLL against a target the player set before pressing the button, with no cash-out, no timer and no round to join. That is exactly Dice (modules/skai-gaming/src/components/play/games/instant/DiceGame.tsx + diceOdds.ts, which already owns the win-chance <-> multiplier <-> threshold <-> Potential Profit conversions and the integer-rail truncation rule for POINTS) and exactly price_grid_settle (supabase/functions/game-settlement/index.ts:13355-13600, `winProbability = (1 / multiplier) * (1 - houseEdge)`, provably-fair roll 0..10000, threshold, max-profit cap, edge read from server config never from bet metadata after IF#1139). GENUINE DIFFERENCES FROM CRASH: no shared multiplayer round (crash needs crashLiveRoundService + a websocket; Limbo does not — every roll is that player's alone), no cash-out and therefore no auto-cashout arming (readAutoCashout is not needed), no growth curve or x-axis (the 250KB of AviatorGamePro that animates and labels the curve has no Limbo analogue), and the target multiplier is the player's INPUT rather than the round's OUTPUT. GENUINE DIFFERENCE FROM DICE: the display is one giant number plus a history chip rail rather than a slider, and there is no over/under condition. BUILD ESTIMATE, WHAT IS ALREADY THERE. The page chrome is a SOLVED, REPEATED PATTERN and is not the work: 9948-24618 is 1440x3294 and 9948-25380 is 375x1605, byte-identical page dimensions to the Chicken frames already shipped as ChickenPage + ChickenPageSections, and the frames are literally a Blackjack page duplicate — the frame titles say "Blackjack", the Community-wins rows all say "Blackjack", and the body copy says "Try Blackjack in Fun Mode" and "highest Blackjack wins" on a page whose H1 reads "Limbo". So the page column (stats/fairness strip, tabs, game-info card, Community wins, More games carousel, Bets panel, About + assurances + Licences + FAQ, footer) is that same template. AND IT IS NO LONGER A COPY JOB — the shared-page-template lane (g-shell) has extracted it into components that now exist and are exported from modules/skai-gaming/src/components/play/shared/index.ts:18-42: PlayGamePageShell, PlayGameTitleRow, PlayGameSection, PlayGameSectionDivider, PlayGameSubBarSurface, PlayGamePageFooter, with the measurements and their source frame IDs pinned in shared/playPageTemplate.ts. Limbo is one of the ELEVEN frames that lane measured as one template, and I confirmed its claim against MY OWN section rather than taking it: 9948-24624 ("Frame 345") is 1318x36 and its children run BACK -> ART -> TITLE in that order — a 24x24 icons/action at x=0 y=6, then a 32x32 rounded-rectangle at x=34 y=2, then the "Limbo" text at x=76 — which is the keno/baccarat order, NOT the reversed Towers order that DiceGame and MinesGame copied. The page column frame 9948-24621 is 1318 wide at x=32 inside a 1382 `main`, i.e. `max-w-[1318px]` with the gutter on a wrapper outside the cap, exactly as that lane documented. So a Limbo page should IMPORT the shell and must not restate a header offset, title size or sub-bar radius locally: doing so duplicates the same change eleven times, and the sub-bar radius in particular is the one nine of ten shipped page files got wrong (12px = `rounded-lg`; `rounded-xl` is 16px in this app). NOTE THE TWO SETS ARE DISJOINT AND LIMBO IS NOT IN THE SHIPPED ONE: eleven is Figma page frames, ten is shipped *PageSections.tsx files, and none of the eleven wave games has a routed page today — so "nine of ten got the radius wrong" is a statement about the shipped ten, not about anything in this section. RADIUS IS A NAME TRAP AND THE LITERAL IS THE FAITHFUL VALUE — I traced this rather than repeating it, because the title row's 32x32 art square (9948-24627) is the first thing a builder will style. THREE different numbers hide behind "md": the Figma file's own `--rounded-md` is 6px (g-shell, via get_design_context on baccarat 9799:16717, which returns the square as `rounded-[var(--rounded-md,6px)]` with a 1px #123f3c border); the token object says 8px (modules/skai-ui/src/lib/design-tokens.ts:1282 `skaiBorderRadius.md`); and the class actually resolves to 10px, because tailwind-preset.ts:392-397 spreads `skaiBorderRadius` and then OVERWRITES lg/md/sm with `var(--radius)` / `calc(var(--radius) - 2px)` / `calc(var(--radius) - 4px)`, and the app sets `--radius: 0.75rem` at src/index.css:539. So `skaiBorderRadius.md`'s 8px is DEAD as a class value (same for sm: token 4px, resolved 8px) and only xl=16 / 2xl=24 survive the spread. Write `rounded-[6px]`, never `rounded-md`. (The `--radius: 0.5rem` at modules/skai-ui/src/design-tokens.css:283 does NOT contradict this — that stylesheet never reaches production, per the verified 2026-08-11 banner at modules/skai-ui/DESIGNER_GUIDE.md:9-25.) The good Limbo copy is already written in the frame: "Set your multiplier. Roll the round. Find out instantly. Anything over it pays and anything under it doesn't. Limbo strips the whole thing down to one call in the Skai Originals lineup." ONE NEW COMPONENT covers all seven non-page frames: a widget of exactly three parts — a board that renders one large multiplier (white 1.00x idle, mint on a win, red on a loss), a history chip rail, and a two-field bar (Multiplier, editable, with a clear x; Win Chance %, derived) that sits on the BOARD not the panel and is shared by both tabs — plus a bet panel that is crash's with the auto block kept and auto-cashout dropped. NEW BACKEND NEEDED — SUPERSEDED BY THE 2026-08-19 CORRECTION ABOVE, which is the current state: none on chain (settleLimbo exists) AND the POINTS path is now built too (_shared/limbo.ts + points-game/index.ts play_limbo). What is STILL missing on the data side: a `gaming_limbo_max_bet` site_config row, a feature-flag row, and a client param encoder — gameCanonParams.ts still returns `null` for limbo, so a chain bet travels the LEGACY scalar path with GameParam = target x 10000. Re-verify all three before relying on this sentence; they were true at the time of writing and this section has already gone stale once in a day. STATES THE FRAMES DO NOT COVER, so they are product decisions not build tasks: both page frames draw the logged-out "Connect wallet" CTA and NO frame draws a signed-in Bet/Roll button, an in-flight/rolling state, an error or offline state, or a win toast; there is no 768 tier; and there is no standalone Manual-tab panel frame at all (Manual appears only inside the two page frames; all four standalone panels are the Auto tab). FRAME DEFECTS TO REPORT UPSTREAM RATHER THAN REPRODUCE: the same 1.58x result is a RED chip in 10004-29705 and a neutral WHITE chip in 10004-29637 after the rail shifts, which implies a third chip state that does not exist; the panels price the bet in SKAI while the Balance row reads "100.11 USDC" and the platform's rails are POINTS/SKAI/sUSD; and "Potential Profit: $1,376.97 / 1376.97 SKAI" on a stake of 1 is placeholder content of the same class as Chicken's fabricated "Total: $89.01", reproducible by no rail and covered by the no-mock-data rule. WHETHER LIMBO SHOULD BE BUILT AT ALL IS CASEY'S CALL AND NOTHING HERE IS A RECOMMENDATION. The facts he needs: the design is 9 real frames and the page half is a copy of a page that already ships; the odds in the frames are real chain odds, not invented; the chain can already settle it; and the reason it would still not be playable on day one is the same reason nothing else settles in sUSD today (the chain money rails are down on an unset service key, and game_history has never recorded a single limbo row). The open questions are scope (page + widget, or widget in the casino modal only), rail (POINTS now vs sUSD later — which decides whether the frames' 1% numbers are the ones a player sees, or whether Limbo follows Dice's 5%), and whether the 2.00-vs-1.9800 desktop/mobile disagreement is a design bug or two different intended defaults. ⚠️ CORRECTED 2026-08-26 (was `not-started`): re-verified live against the Figma page, the route table and prod site_config. See status.game-rollups.verified.tsv for the evidence.

10004-29637 DESKTOP BOARD, WIN STATE, 954x621.
